transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just here because I keep messing up little things. Just... careless stuff. Like writing the wrong time down on a class sheet at the senior center. Or... I'll measure a board for a project, and I still end up cutting it a hair short because I just sort of skip over the small print on the tape measure. Just things like that, mostly.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried a lot of the time, even when there isn't a clear reason for it?
No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things, I guess. But... no, not all the time or anything.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy lately?
No, not really. Um... I still enjoy my projects and things. I just... no, I feel fine.
Have you noticed any difficulties with your memory, concentration, or thinking clearly lately?

Um... maybe concentrating. Like, if I'm at the senior center... and people are talking at the next table, or my phone lights up... my mind just jumps over there. I end up losing my place in whatever I was filling out, or... building. Just stuff like that.
Do you find it hard to concentrate even when you're in a quiet place without any distractions, or does it only happen when there's something else going on around you?
I don't know. Um... mostly just when there's stuff going on around me, I think. If it's quiet... I haven't really noticed.
When you're by yourself in a quiet place, do you still find it hard to focus or does your mind tend to wander?
Um... no, not really. If it's quiet, I guess I'm okay. I just... I haven't really paid attention to that.
When you're in a quiet place by yourself, do you ever notice yourself getting distracted easily or having trouble staying focused on what you're doing?
I... I think I just said. Um, no. If nobody's around and it's quiet... I'm fine. I don't really have a problem then.
When you're working on a project or task that you find interesting and engaging, do you still have trouble focusing, or does that help you stay on track?
I... I don't know. If I like it, I guess I just do it. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you find it harder to stay focused during tasks that are repetitive or not very stimulating, like filling out forms or listening to a long meeting at the senior center?
Well... I don't really go to meetings. Um... and forms, I just... if I have to fill one out, I just do it. I haven't really noticed it being a problem, I guess.
Do you find it harder to pay attention when you're doing something that isn't very interesting to you, like routine chores or listening to something you don't care much about?
I mean... chores are just chores, you know? You just get them done. I don't really... I wouldn't say I have a hard time with it. I just do what needs doing.
Do you find it harder to pay attention when you're doing something that isn't very interesting to you, like routine chores or listening to something you don't care much about?

I think... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, I don't really think about it. If someone's talking about something I don't care about, I just... sit there, I guess. I haven't really noticed it being any harder. It's just normal life.
Looking back over the past few months, have you ever felt a need to stop yourself from thinking about things that were bothering you, even when you wanted to focus on something else?

Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really dwell on things. If something's bothering me, I just... I don't know, I just let it be, I guess. I haven't really had to force myself to stop thinking about anything.
Do you find it hard to organize tasks or keep track of multiple things when you're working on something, like a project or planning an event at the senior center?

I suppose... sometimes. If there's a lot going on. Like, if I have a few errands to run, and maybe a workshop to get ready for, plus an appointment all on the same day... I don't know. I guess I have a little trouble putting them in the right order. I might start one thing, then stop... and just end up rushing around at the end of the day. But... it is what it is.
Do you notice these kinds of problems happening in different places, like at home, at the senior center, or when you’re out running errands, or does it mostly happen in just one setting?
I don't know... I guess it just happens wherever. It's not really tied to one place. Just... whenever I have a lot to do, I suppose. It's just how it goes.
When you're doing something that requires sustained attention, like reading a manual or filling out paperwork, do you find yourself losing focus or making careless mistakes more often?

I guess so... yeah. That's sort of why I'm here, actually. I just... I keep messing up little things. Like at the center, I'll write the wrong time down on the class sign-up sheet. Or... if I'm doing a project at home, I'll measure a board, and then I'll cut it, and it's still a hair short. I just... I guess I skip over the small print or don't look close enough. It just happens.
Have you ever had days where you felt down or hopeless for most of the day, even when there wasn’t a clear reason for it?
No... not really. I mean, everybody has a bad day now and then, but... no, I wouldn't say I feel hopeless. Just... frustrated with myself sometimes, I guess. But that's about it.
